entities.summary: Glastonbury is a town and civil parish in Somerset, England, situated at a dry point on the low-lying Somerset Levels, 23 miles (37 km) south of Bristol. The town had a population of 8,932 in the 2011 census. The town is less than 1 mile (2 km) across the River Brue from Street, a village which is now larger than Glastonbury.
